quests.instruction: What is the name for the small pouch sewn into pants or a jacket for holding tiny things? It is also the pouch we slip our hand into to keep our fingers warm!
quests.question: Pocket
quests.hint: It is a small feature, not something you would wear by itself!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Pocket is a small pouch sewn in for holding coins, toys, or notes!
quests.funFact: A pocket is a small pouch sewn right into your clothes for holding things!

quests.instruction: What is the name for the small, round piece we push through a little hole to close a shirt? It is also the piece we do up carefully, one at a time, from bottom to top!
quests.question: Button
quests.hint: It is small and round!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Button is a small piece that pushes through a hole to close your clothes!
quests.funFact: A button is a small, round piece that pushes through a hole to close clothes!

quests.instruction: What is the name for the fuzzy strip that sticks together with a satisfying rip sound? It is also the sticky strip that closes instead of laces, buttons, or a zipper!
quests.question: Velcro
quests.hint: It makes a satisfying ripping sound!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Velcro is a fuzzy fastener that sticks together with a satisfying rip!
quests.funFact: Velcro makes a fun ripping sound when you pull it apart!

quests.instruction: What is the name for the long strings we thread through little holes and tie in a bow? It is also the strings we practice tying into a neat bow as we learn to dress ourselves!
quests.question: Shoelaces
quests.hint: They are long strings, not a whole shoe!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Shoelaces are the strings that tie into a bow to keep your shoes snug!
quests.funFact: Shoelaces are long strings that tie into a bow to keep shoes snug!

quests.instruction: What is the name for the end of a sleeve that circles snugly around our wrist? It is also the part of a jacket sleeve that stops right at our hand!
quests.question: Cuff
quests.hint: This one is a small detail, not a full garment!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Cuff is the end of a sleeve that circles snugly around your wrist!
quests.funFact: A cuff is the end of a sleeve that circles snugly around your wrist!

quests.instruction: What is the name for the row of tiny teeth we zip up in one smooth pull? It is also the fastener with a little metal tab we pull up and down!
quests.question: Zipper
quests.hint: It has a row of tiny teeth!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Zipper has tiny teeth that lock together in one smooth pull to close clothes!
quests.funFact: A zipper has tiny teeth that lock together in one smooth pull!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on a freezing, windy day to keep our ears from hurting, and also over our ears, connected by a padded band across our head?
quests.question: Earmuffs
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They cover just your ears, not your whole head!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Earmuffs cover just your ears with a padded band, keeping them warm!
quests.funFact: Earmuffs only cover your ears, connected by a band over your head!

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear that hugs our whole head snugly, with no brim at all?
quests.question: Beanie
quests.hint: Think about this: It is soft, stretchy, and knitted.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Beanie is a snug knitted hat with no brim, keeping your whole head warm!
quests.funFact: Beanies are knitted from soft, stretchy yarn, just like a cozy sweater.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear when we jump and splash in puddles after a storm?
quests.question: Rain Boots
quests.hint: Think about this: They are perfect for jumping in puddles.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Rain Boots are made of waterproof rubber, keeping your feet dry in puddles!
quests.funFact: Jumping in a puddle is much more fun with rain boots on.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear that is thin and light, but still blocks a gusty breeze?
quests.question: Windbreaker
quests.hint: Think about this: It makes a soft rustling sound when you move.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Windbreaker is thin and light, yet still blocks a gusty breeze!
quests.funFact: Windbreakers often rustle softly because of their smooth, light fabric.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear instead of a T-shirt, when even short sleeves feel too warm, and also on a very hot day, to keep our arms totally cool?
quests.question: Tank Top
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It has no sleeves, only two thin straps!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Tank Top has no sleeves at all, keeping your arms cool on hot days!
quests.funFact: A tank top has no sleeves at all, just two thin straps!

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear over our clothes while we bake cookies or paint a picture?
quests.question: Apron
quests.hint: Think about this: It ties around your neck and waist.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Apron ties over your clothes to protect them from spills and splashes!
quests.funFact: Chefs and painters both wear aprons to protect their outfits.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear that every student at the same school wears together?
quests.question: Uniform
quests.hint: Think about this: It shows which group someone belongs to.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Uniform is worn by everyone on the same team or school, all matching!
quests.funFact: Sports teams wear matching uniforms so players are easy to spot.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear that keeps our chest and back warm but arms free?
quests.question: Vest
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wear this over a shirt.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Vest covers your chest with no sleeves, so your arms stay free!
quests.funFact: A bright orange safety vest helps workers be seen easily.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear instead of shoes, right after we wake up in the morning?
quests.question: Slippers
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They keep your feet warm on a cold floor.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Slippers are soft and easy to slide on, perfect for relaxing at home!
quests.funFact: Fuzzy slippers keep your feet warm on cold morning floors.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear first, before we put on our shirt and pants?
quests.question: Underwear
quests.hint: Here's a tip: No one else can see it once you're dressed.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Underwear is worn closest to your skin, under all your other clothes!
quests.funFact: Underwear comes in soft, comfortable cotton and fun colorful patterns.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear with soft, bouncy soles that cushion every step?
quests.question: Sneakers
quests.hint: Here's a tip: Athletes wear these during a race.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Sneakers have bouncy soles that make running and jumping comfortable!
quests.funFact: Some sneakers even light up with every single step.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that has pockets for keeping small things safe?
quests.question: Pants
quests.hint: They have two long tubes, one for each leg.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Pants cover both your legs to keep them warm and safe!
quests.funFact: Long ago, only certain people wore pants, but now almost everyone does.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that can be short or reach down to our ankles?
quests.question: Skirt
quests.hint: It is worn with a top, not by itself.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Skirt hangs down from your waist and can swish as you walk!
quests.funFact: Skirts can be short, long, stripy, or full of colorful patterns.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear on our hands when it is cold outside?
quests.question: Gloves
quests.hint: Hint: You wear these to make a snowball without cold hands.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Gloves keep every finger warm and toasty in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Gloves give our fingers a warm hug in winter!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear with our coat on the coldest days of the year?
quests.question: Scarf
quests.hint: It can be long and dangly or short and cozy.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Scarf wraps around your neck to keep it warm and cozy!
quests.funFact: A long scarf can be wrapped around your neck more than once.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear instead of closed shoes when the weather is hot, and also with open straps that let our toes feel the breeze?
quests.question: Sandals
quests.hint: Your toes can peek out of these!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Sandals have open straps that let your feet stay cool in the sun!
quests.funFact: Sandals let your toes feel fresh air on a hot day!

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear to stay warm and cozy indoors?
quests.question: Sweater
quests.hint: Hint: Grandparents sometimes knit these by hand.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Sweater is soft and warm, perfect for chilly days indoors or out!
quests.funFact: Many sweaters are knitted from soft, warm yarn!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear first, before we put a jacket on over it?
quests.question: Shirt
quests.hint: It has two sleeves for your arms.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Shirt covers your chest and back to keep your top half comfy!
quests.funFact: Some shirts have buttons, and some just pull over your head.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear over everything else when it is very cold outside?
quests.question: Coat
quests.hint: Hint: It is your best friend on a snowy day.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Coat is thick and warm, worn over everything else in cold weather!
quests.funFact: A warm coat can keep you toasty even in freezing weather!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear backward sometimes just for fun, and also with a soft, rounded top and no floppy edges?
quests.question: Cap
quests.hint: It has a curved brim just at the front!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Cap has a curved front brim that shades your eyes from the sun!
quests.funFact: A cap has a curved brim only at the front, not all the way around!

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear on our feet under our shoes?
quests.question: Socks
quests.hint: Hint: They are soft and can have fun patterns.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Socks keep your feet warm and make your shoes comfortable!
quests.funFact: Socks keep our feet warm and make shoes comfortable!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear instead of a plain sweater, for extra warmth and fun, and also when we want a warm top with a hood attached?
quests.question: Hoodie
quests.hint: It has a hood attached at the neck!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Hoodie has a warm hood attached that you can pull up over your head!
quests.funFact: A hoodie has its own built-in hood you can pull up any time!

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear with just one strap that fits between our big toe and the next?
quests.question: Flip-Flops
quests.hint: Think about this: They make a fun slapping sound as you walk.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Flip-Flops have one simple strap and slide on fast for easy beach days!
quests.funFact: A flip-flop has just one strap, between your big toe and the next.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear on our legs on a hot summer day?
quests.question: Shorts
quests.hint: Hint: You wear these when it is too hot for pants.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Shorts keep your legs cool and free to move on hot days!
quests.funFact: Shorts keep your legs cool on hot summer days!
